description: The server's review of a synced return (sync spec §6.2, SYN-03, D-011, W1-13): never a refusal, only findings. `original` is bill C03-S000412 as the server holds it (its status, business date, and each line as sold with what other returns took of it and whether it is itself a returned line), or null when the server doesn't have it. `items` gives an item's category policy (returnable, windowDays); the tenant window is 30 days. The roles are the server's (testing/returns.ts). Findings: return_original_invalid per line (missing, voided, other_item, returned_line), return_over_quantity per line (sold, returnedBefore, qty), return_price_mismatch per line (linked: the refund refundFor gives on the server's figures; no_receipt: qty × the approved price on the no_receipt_return override; expected null when there is none), then return_not_permitted per need (permission, outside_policy, no_receipt, transfer; approval missing or not_permitted). Two returned lines of one original line are judged one after the other. Documents as in return-document.json.

the original isn't on the server
the original line isn't on it
the original was voided
the original line is another item
the original line is itself a returned line
another counter returned it first, offline
two lines of one document returning the same pad
a refund above what was paid

a no-receipt refund other than the approved price

permission and policy approved by the manager: nothing
the seller lacked the permission and nobody approved

a non-returnable category, approved by a senior salesman who may not
